description: Fix all P0 and P1 security/architecture issues from the code review: remove private key logging, strengthen MCP input sanitization, secure passphrase generation, add evaluation mutex, and add URL validation for /scan command.
steps: P0-1: In src/index.ts printBanner(), remove the line that logs last 8 chars of SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY. Replace with just logging 'configured' or 'not configured' (do NOT include any part of the key).

P0-2: In src/core/mcp.ts, strengthen SHELL_INJECTION_PATTERNS regex to also detect newline chars (\n, \r, \x0a, \x0d), additional shell metacharacters (>, <, #, !, ~, ^(caret in shell context), \\). Update sanitizeInputs to handle arrays: if a value is an Array, iterate elements and check each string element. Keep existing nested object recursion.

P1-3: In src/config.ts, remove the code that writes the passphrase to a file (writeFileSync to data/auth-passphrase.txt). Instead, only output the passphrase to stdout (console.log) on first run. Add a comment noting this is intentional - the passphrase is shown once at startup and never persisted to disk.

P1-4: In src/core/agent.ts evaluateStrategies(), add a private instance variable `private evaluating = false`. At the top of evaluateStrategies(), check if `this.evaluating` is true - if so, return early. Set it to true at the start, and set it back to false in a finally block at the end of the method.

P1-5: In src/telegram/commands/security.ts, add URL protocol validation for the /scan command. After the existing URL format validation (try { new URL(target) }), add a check that the URL protocol is http: or https: only. Reject file://, ftp://, javascript:, data:, and other protocols with an appropriate error message.
acceptance_criteria: printBanner() does not log any portion of SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY - only logs 'configured' or 'not configured'
MCP sanitizeInputs detects newlines in string values
MCP sanitizeInputs handles array params by checking each string element
No passphrase file is written to disk - passphrase only shown in stdout
evaluateStrategies() has a mutex guard preventing concurrent execution
`npm test` passes (update tests if needed to match new behavior)
findings: All 5 fixes implemented successfully. Build passes and all 590 tests pass without modification. The expanded SHELL_INJECTION_PATTERNS regex did not break any existing tests since existing test cases used patterns (semicolons, pipes, backticks, &&, $()) that are still caught by the new regex.
